title: ObservationWriteRequest
description: Payload a microservice POSTs to {mycelium}/api/things/{thingId}/properties/{property}/observations to record one sampled Observation (the queued/batched telemetry write kind). Shape derived from vos.Service.Shared.MyceliumClientBase.RecordObservationAsync and Mycelium's ObservationWriteDto.

value.description: The sampled value: any JSON scalar (string, number, boolean) or null.

observedAt.description: Source-supplied observed-time as an ISO-8601 string. Omit to let Mycelium stamp now (UTC); set it for late or out-of-order samples.
